title: Outstandingly Buttery German Potato Dumplings
description: A show-off German dish featuring pillowy potato dumplings served with enchilada sauce in an agave leaf vessel, tempered to perfection and shojin-friendly.
instructions: Boil the potatoes until tender, then mash and set aside.
In a large bowl, combine the flour, melted butter, egg, salt, and pepper, and mix until a dough forms.
Add the mashed potatoes to the dough and mix until well combined.
Divide the dough into 8 equal pieces and shape each into a ball.
Place each ball onto a large agave leaf, leaving space between each dumpling.
Spoon the enchilada sauce over the dumplings, making sure they are fully coated.
Temper the dumplings by placing them in the oven for 10 minutes, then removing and letting cool for 5 minutes.
Serve the dumplings hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
